svg.text: Extreme Strips: Coprime Inputs Collapse to {1}; Zero Inputs Fill All of ℕ
The same definition Div(g) = Div(a) ∩ Div(b) handles coprime numbers and a = b = 0 without special cases
Case A — Coprime Inputs (a = 13, b = 8): Div(13) and Div(8) share only d = 1, so Gcd(13, 8) = { 1 }
Case B — All-Zero Inputs (a = 0, b = 0): Every d ∈ ℕ divides 0 (since 0 = d · 0), so Div(0) = ℕ and Gcd(0, 0) = { 0 }
Every g > 0 has only finitely many divisors, leaving infinitely many sockets empty!
